content: KAUN-O Koasoanehdi mehn Israel ko en Mweselsang Nahna Sainai

KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “Mweselsang wasaht, iangahki aramas akan me ke kahredo sang Isip. Kumwail kohwei nan sahpw me I inoukihda me I pahn kihong Eipraam, Aisek, Seikop, oh pil kadaudokarail kan.
I pahn kadarowei emen tohnleng pwehn kahluwaikumwail. I pahn kasarehla mehn Kenan kan, mehn Amor kan, mehn Id kan, mehn Peris kan, mehn Ip oh mehn Sepus kan.
Kumwail pahn kohwei nan sahpw kaselel oh reken dipwisou. Ahpw I sohte pahn iang kumwail, pwehki amwail nan kapehd keptakai, I de kauweikumwailla nanialo.”
Ahnsou me aramas ako rongada mahsen kansensuwed wet, re tapihada mwahiei oh kihsang arail kapwat akan.

Pwe KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses en ndaiong irail, “Aramas keptakai kei kumwail. Ma I pahn iang kumwail kohwei, mehnda ma ahnsoutehkis, I uhdahn pahn kamwomwkumwailla. Eri, kumwail kihsang noumwail kisin kohl kan; I ahpw pahn ese dahme I pahn wiahiong kumwail.”
Eri, ni arail mweselsang Nahna Sainai, mehn Israel ko sohla kapwatki kisin kohl.
Sapwellimen KAUN-O Impwal

Wasa koaros me mehn Israel kan pahn kin kauwada ie imwarail impwal akan, Moses kin epwehnki kauwada Impwal sarawio ekis dohlahsang imwarail impwal ko. Me adaneki Impwal me KAUN-O kin ketiket loale, oh mehmen me kin anahne tuhkihong KAUN-O mehkot, pahn kin kohla wasao.
Ahnsou koaros me Moses pahn pwarala wasao, aramas koaros pahn kesihnenda ni wenihmwen imwarail impwal kan oh kilikilang Moses e lao kin pedolong loale.
Mwurin, Moses eh kin pedolong loale, pelien depwek pali kin kohdi oh perehla wenihmwen Impwalo, KAUN-O ahpw kin ketin mahseniong Moses sang nan pelien depweko.
Ahnsou me aramas ako pahn kilang pelien depweko ni wenihmwen Impwalo, re kin poaridi.

KAUN-O ahpw kin ketin mahseniong Moses ni sansal mehlel, duwehte aramas emen eh kin lokaiaiong kompoakepah. Moses ahpw kin pwurala nan kahnimpwalo, a mwahnakapw me kin seweseo, me ede Sosua, nein Nun, e kin mihmihte nan Impwalo.
KAUN-O Inoukihda me e pahn ketin Ieiang Sapwellime Aramas akan

Moses ahpw patohwanohng KAUN-O, “Maing, mehlel pwoat me komw ketin mahsanih I en kahluwalahng aramas pwukat nan sahpwo, ahpw komw sohte ketin mahsanihong ie ihs me pahn iang ie patohla. Komw ketin mahsaniher me komwi mwahngih mehlel duwen ngehi, oh komw kupwurperenkin ie.

Eri, ma komw kupwurperenkin ie, I patohwan peki rehmwi, komwi en ketin kasalehiong ie kupwuromwien, pwe I en dadaurete ei kin papah komwi oh kin kaparanda kupwuromwi. Komwi en pil tamataman aramas pwukat me komw ketin piladahr pwehn wiahla sapwellimomwi.”
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanih, “I pahn ieiang uhk, pwe ke en powehdi.”
Moses ahpw sapengki, “Ma komw sohte pahn ketin ieiang kiht, a komw dehr kadarkitala sang wasa kiset.

Pwe ia duwen at pahn ese me komw ketin kupwurperenkin ie oh sapwellimomwi aramas akan, ma komw sohte ketin ieiang kiht? Ma komw pahn ketin ieiang kiht, se uhdahn pahn keniken pahn kupwuromwi mwohn aramas teikan en sampah.”
KAUN-O ahpw mahsanihong Moses, “I pahn kapwaiada me ke ahpwtehn ndahn, pwehki ei kin kupwurperenkin uhk oh mwahngihiuk mehlel.”
Moses eri peki rehn KAUN-O, patohwan, “Maing, komw ketin kupwurkalahngan kasalehiong ie mahs omwi lingaling.”
KAUN-O ahpw ketin sapeng, mahsanih, “Eri, I pahn kasalehiong uhk ei lingan koaros, oh I pahn masanihada mwohmw mwarei; iei mwarei, KAUN-O, oh I me kin kupwurkalahngan ong irail kan me I kin pilada.
Ke sohte kak kilang ie, pwe sohte aramas emen kak kilang ie ahpw momour;
ahpw iet wasa kis limwahi me ke kak kesihnenda pohn paip ehu.
Ni ahnsou me ei lingaling pahn lel met, I pahn kihdiong uhk nan peden paipo, oh perehkihla pehiet mesomwen, I lao daulihiuk.
A I ahpw pahn kihsang pehiet, ke ahpw pahn kak kilang tihnseweiet, a kaidehk silangiet.”
